author: "Nihar Shah"
date: "October 11, 2026"
output: html_document
---

## Data

```{r}
library(forecast)

airline_data <- read.csv("us_domestic_airline_enplanements_monthly.csv")
passengers <- ts(airline_data$ENPLANED, start = c(2000, 1), frequency = 12)

head(passengers)
plot(passengers, main = "Monthly airline boardings",
     xlab = "Year", ylab = "Thousands of boardings")
```

## STL decomposition

```{r}
stl_decomp <- stl(passengers, s.window = "periodic")
plot(stl_decomp)
attributes(stl_decomp)
```

## Seasonally adjusted data

```{r}
head(seasadj(stl_decomp))

plot(passengers, main = "Actual and seasonally adjusted data",
     xlab = "Year", ylab = "Thousands of boardings")
lines(seasadj(stl_decomp), col = "red")
legend("topleft", c("Actual", "Seasonally adjusted"),
       col = c("black", "red"), lty = 1, bty = "n")
```

## Forecast from STL

```{r}
f_stl <- forecast(stl_decomp, h = 15)
f_stl
plot(f_stl, ylab = "Thousands of boardings")
```

## Classical decomposition

```{r}
decomp_airline <- decompose(passengers)
plot(decomp_airline)
attributes(decomp_airline)
head(seasadj(decomp_airline))
```
